en: A black-and-white photographic postcard showing a wide, tree-lined avenue with people walking on the sidewalks and a few early 20th-century automobiles on the street. In the distance, a prominent building sits atop a hill. The lower text identifies the street as 'Paseo de la Reforma para Chapultepec.' The scene conveys an elegant, expansive boulevard with vintage street lamps.
